messages:
Liam: Invoice from CrescentCompute (INV-2026-512) arrived; AP auto-match put it on PO-512 (storage contract) but invoice items are for embeddings GPU hours. Attachment: cc_inv_512.pdf
Jorge: I pulled the invoice. OCR reads PO#: 7721 (handwritten near bottom) but our vendor alias mapping linked CrescentCompute to old vendor id and matched 512.
FinanceBot: INV-2026-512 received. Auto-match: PO-512 (confidence 0.82). OCR_confidence for PO field=0.38. Amount $9,120.00.
Liam: This should be PO-7721 (Eng model infra commitment). Can someone create a manual remap and route to Eng Finance approver?
ProcurementBot: Vendor CrescentCompute has aliases: CrescentCompute Inc., Crescent Compute LLC. Duplicate vendor records found. Recommend merge ticket PROC-902.
AP_Team: We can manual-remap to PO-7721 but need written approval from PO owner and reassign approver. Current approver for PO-512 is Finance Ops (Jorge). Approver for PO-7721 is Tara.
Tara: Looking at PO-7721, scope includes embeddings and model-serving. I approve remap for INV-2026-512 to PO-7721 and GL 4012-CloudOps. Note: please confirm there are no prior credits.
Jorge: Confirmed no prior credits on file. I updated the invoice record: manual match -> PO-7721, GL set to 4012-CloudOps, payment hold until vendor consolidation ticket PROC-902 completes.
FinanceBot: Invoice status updated: Remapped to PO-7721, Held (awaiting vendor merge). JIRA FIN-3427 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3427
Liam: I emailed CrescentCompute acct team to confirm alias and asked for a corrected PDF. Vendor replied they will resend with typed PO reference within 24 hrs.
ProcurementBot: PROC-902 created and assigned to Procurement for duplicate vendor cleanup.
Tara: OK to release payment once corrected invoice arrives or vendor confirms in writing. I will approve final payment in AP queue then.
AP_Team: Acknowledged. Will monitor FIN-3427 and unhold once vendor confirms.
Liam: Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open until corrected invoice lands.
